question: Which of the following parts/structures is located at the topmost part of a Stupa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmika**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Harmika is located at the topmost part of a stupa**.
 
• It is a **square railing-like structure that sits atop the stupa's dome**, symbolizing the heavens or the divine realm.
 
• The** Harmika is symbolic of the heavens or the divine realm. **
 
• **I**t** represents the connection between the earthly realm and the celestial realm, **often interpreted as the abode of the gods or a representation of the Buddhist cosmos.
 
• The **presence of the Harmika is a reminder of the Buddha's teachings** transcending the material world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c258c840ce272854a3c2d5559462b7a92b55d2d13dcdc5bc080e165fdc2f8eae.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Characteristics of Stupa:

 
 
• Initially, mounds of Earth are encased in bricks.
 
• Stupas are usually built on a foundation laid with blocks of stone or bricks. 
 
• On this foundation, a hemispherical dome was raised called Anda. 
 
• The drum of the stupa became more elongated and elevated.
 
• It took the form of a cylindrical vessel. 
 
• On the truncated top of the hemisphere, a harmonica is placed, surrounded by a railing.
 
• The railing is provided with four gateways.
 
• A path of circumambulation runs around the stupa at the ground level within the railing called Pradakshinapath.
 
• Toranas were ceremonial gateways around the stupas
 
• ​The wooden or stone railing that surrounds the stupa called Vedika
